scoring_justification: T1 recompute infeasible because the checker cannot re-run the massive 3D phase-field simulation; T2 consistency requires per-region raw data not submitted. We instead score the histogram bins against the paper’s reference with tolerance, which is a structural verification of the nearest-neighbor distribution.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference nearest-neighbor relative frequencies for Ag₂Al and Al₂Cu extracted from Fig. 6 of the paper (EXP dataset, 800² base size simulation).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from the experimental micrograph comparison in the paper; approximate values captured from Fig. 6 (Ag₂Al and Al₂Cu neighbor count histograms).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manually extracted frequencies from the published figure; values were rounded to two decimal places. The reference solve.sh uses these exact numbers to produce the correct artifacts.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These values correspond to the nearest-neighbor statistics that the paper’s EXP simulation produces, and are the hidden gold for comparing the agent’s computed histograms. They are embedded here to avoid requiring separate files.

outputs.description: Histogram of nearest-neighbor counts for Ag₂Al regions: neighbor_count (integer) and relative_frequency (float).
Histogram of nearest-neighbor counts for Al₂Cu regions: neighbor_count (integer) and relative_frequency (float).

output_contract.notes: Scoring compares bin-wise relative frequencies to the paper's experimental reference histogram (derived from Fig. 6) using a per-bin absolute tolerance. No gold values are disclosed to the agent.

steps.description: Compare Ag2Al nearest-neighbor histogram bins to paper reference (Fig. 6a).
Compare Al2Cu nearest-neighbor histogram bins to paper reference (Fig. 6b).
